traitor.title: Traitor's Tome
traitor.text:
### Setup
- Your explorer stays in the game but is now the traitor.
- Place a small red monster token on your explorer's character card.
- You are now a Werewolf:
  - Drop all your items.
  - If you have custody of the Girl or the Madman, you lose it. Set those cards aside and adjust your traits to match. Represent them with small monster tokens; they stay in that room and other explorers can collect them.
  - Raise any trait that is below its starting value back to its starting value.
  - Then gain 1 trait point per hero in the game, spent across your traits as you choose (e.g. 3 heroes gives 3 points total, not 3 points in every trait).
- The Dog: place a small orange monster token in your room. It is the Dog, a monster you control. You do not need the Dog card; the Dog follows this haunt's rules.

### Monsters
- Dog — Speed 4 · Might 4 · Sanity 3

### Rules
#### You Must Do This at the beginning of each of your turns
- Gain 1 Might or 1 Speed. You cannot raise a trait above the maximum printed on your character card.

#### Special Attack Rules
- When you or the Dog defeats a hero, the hero takes damage as usual. Then, at the start of each of that hero's later turns, the hero must try a Sanity roll of 4+ to resist the curse. On a failure, that hero becomes a Werewolf and stops being a hero; that player then reads this haunt in the Traitor's Tome and does everything listed under "Right Now".
- No Werewolf trait can be lowered to the skull symbol unless the attack uses a special item described in the Secrets of Survival booklet. All damage a Werewolf takes from any other source is halved, rounded up.
- Neither Werewolves nor the Dog can carry items or use elevators.
- If you win and another Werewolf has killed a hero, that Werewolf's player also wins.

> Note: "each of that hero's subsequent turns" has no stated end — a hero defeated once keeps rolling every turn until a roll fails or the game ends.
> Resolution (unresolved): no ruling found. The revised 1st-edition Secrets of Survival has a bitten hero hold a Wolf token and roll "at the start of each of your subsequent turns". It gives no end except a failed roll. Source: http://web.archive.org/web/20060110122045/http://www.wizards.com:80/avalonhill/rules/BHH_SurvivalRev_120105.pdf
> Note: a newly turned Werewolf following "Right Now" would also place a Dog per the "The Dog" instruction only if that section is read as part of Right Now; the book prints "The Dog" as a separate section after "You Must Do This", so a new Werewolf does not appear to get a Dog.
> Resolution (unresolved): no ruling found. In one BGG thread, a group decided that only the original traitor controls the Dog and that new Werewolves add no Dog turns. Only one reply backed them, which is not consensus. Source: https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/835079

### Traitor wins when
- Every hero is either dead or has turned into a Werewolf.

### What they know about the other side
- Nothing: you probably knew something about them, but you are now too wolfish to remember.

heroes.title: Secrets of Survival
heroes.text:
### Setup
- Set aside small red monster tokens equal to the number of players in the game.
- Set aside one pentagonal item token (representing Silver Bullets).
### Rules
#### How to Kill Werewolves
- The heroes must find the Revolver and create Silver Bullets, through the steps below. Each hero can attempt a step only once per turn.
  1. A hero who doesn't have the Revolver can find it in the Attic, Game Room, Junk Room, Master Bedroom or Vault. While in one of those rooms, the hero can attempt a Knowledge roll of 5+. On a success, search the item stack for the Revolver card, take it, then shuffle the item stack. A hero can search more than once in the same room, but not more than once per turn.
  2. In the Research Laboratory or the Furnace Room, a hero can attempt a Knowledge roll of 5+ to create Silver Bullets. On a success, that hero takes the Silver Bullets token. One explorer can work on the Silver Bullets while another looks for the Revolver; these two tasks can be done in either order.
  3. The hero who created the Silver Bullets must give them to the hero who has the Revolver, or the other way round.
  4. A hero who has both the Silver Bullets and the Revolver can kill a Werewolf or the Dog (see Special Attack Rules).
> Note: Unlike most haunts, the steps are not stated to be done in order; step 2 explicitly lets finding the Revolver and making the Silver Bullets happen in either order.
> Resolution (unresolved): no ruling needed, and none found. The revised 1st-edition Secrets of Survival also omits "in order" and says the two tasks "can be done in either order". Source: http://web.archive.org/web/20060110122045/http://www.wizards.com:80/avalonhill/rules/BHH_SurvivalRev_120105.pdf
#### You Must Do This on Your Turn
- A hero who is attacked by a Werewolf or the Dog and takes damage has been bitten and may be affected by the curse of lycanthropy.
- At the start of each of that hero's later turns, the hero must attempt a Sanity roll of 4+ to resist the curse. On a failure, the hero becomes a Werewolf and is no longer a hero; that player must read this haunt in the Traitor's Tome and do everything listed under "Right Now".
- Heroes who were bitten but have so far resisted becoming Werewolves still win if the Werewolves are killed.
#### Special Attack Rules
- If a hero who has the Silver Bullets defeats a Werewolf or the Dog once using the Revolver, that Werewolf or Dog is killed.
- The Revolver never runs out of bullets.
### Heroes win when
- All of the Werewolves are dead. The heroes do not need to kill the Dog.
### What they know about the other side
- The traitor is a Werewolf that will grow more and more powerful.
- A Werewolf can infect others with lycanthropy, turning them into Werewolves too.
